_comment: The EDID OpenBezel serves on this board (Kconfig: EDID > OpenBezel), built by tools/gen_edid.py.
vendor: a 3-letter PNP ID.  OBZ is not a registered ID - change it if you have one.
Modes: the input timings hdmi_rx.c's mode table has capture profiles for, minus 1600x900
(its CVT-RB row shows a blocky, jittery picture).
Color: RGB 4:4:4 only (no YCbCr, no deep color) - what the receiver supports.
name: OpenBezel

preferred._comment: 1920x1080p60, CTA VIC 16: the panel's native mode

detailed._comment: 1680x1050p60 CVT reduced blanking (the mode table has RB, not DMT's normal blanking)
